# Dashboard screenshot comparison with blur on dynamic metrics.
# The page has random user counts, RPS, latency, and event timestamps
# that change on every load. Blur those elements so the stable layout
# (headings, uptime, structure) drives the comparison.

navigate /blur-dashboard.html
wait-visible '#dashboard'
sleep 500ms

# Baseline capture: blur all dynamic values.
screenshot-compare --threshold 15 --blur '#users' --blur '#rps' --blur '#latency' --blur '#evt1' --blur '#evt2' --blur '#evt3' '#dashboard' dashboard.png
stdout 'baseline created'

# Reload; all dynamic values change.
navigate /blur-dashboard.html
wait-visible '#dashboard'
sleep 500ms

# Second capture should be within threshold.
screenshot-compare --threshold 15 --blur '#users' --blur '#rps' --blur '#latency' --blur '#evt1' --blur '#evt2' --blur '#evt3' '#dashboard' dashboard.png
stdout 'diff:'
